FA/Draft-60 pool methodology -- went through several owner-reviewed iterations (oRank-only, then cap-primary/dynasty-tiebreak, then cap-primary/blended-tiebreak) before landing on the final design, explicitly redirected by the owner: 'Rebuild FA/DRAFT 60 as a likely draft-value board, not a dynasty-prospect list or cap-sorted inventory.' FINAL methodology: (1) universe = every projected cut across all 16 teams UNION every non-kept Yahoo-ranked player (300-fetch), with dynasty consensus used ONLY to backfill names missing from Yahoo (~105 players, mostly rookies/deep bench) so they aren't invisible -- 3 cut players found on neither source (Jamir Watkins, Chaney Johnson, Matisse Thybulle) are force-included with conservative defaults so 'all projected cuts' is literal; (2) composite score = 1.0*yahooScore + 0.25*dynastyScore + 1.0*capDollars, where yahooScore=301-oRank and dynastyScore=401-dynastyRank -- Yahoo dominant, dynasty secondary, cap a modest signal, CAP column intentionally NOT monotonic; (3) a player missing from Yahoo's fetch gets a conservative oRank proxy of 301 (worse than every real Yahoo rank) specifically so dynasty coverage alone can never crowd out an established Yahoo top-150/180 player -- dynasty's max possible contribution (0.25*400=100) stays under a real oRank-180 player's Yahoo score alone (121), by design, not chance.
